text:
maria: kicking off kernel backport canary in eu-west-1 today 15:00 UTC. goal is to reduce XID/ECC spikes we've seen the last 2 weeks. considering kpatch hotpatch vs full reboot. need drain/replacement plan + capacity estimate. tagging @priya @jonathan for input. infra-bot: scheduled pre-canary health checks at 14:30 UTC.

priya: prefer a small, multi-AZ canary — 3 hosts across 2 AZs, plus 2 holdouts for quick rollback. pick nodes with low allocations and some previously flaky cards (label: gpu.flaky=true).

jonathan: agree. recommend two-phase: 1) kpatch hotpatch on 3 non-critical hosts, monitor 24h for regressions/XID, 2) if stable, staged reboot rollout with 10% batch sizes. if hotpatch shows any new kernel oops or driver warnings -> immediate rollback.

lee: monitoring queries we should watch (promql):
```
increase(gpu_xid_errors_total[1h])
rate(gpu_ecc_corrected_total[1h])
(sum by(node)(increase(dmesg_xid_occurrences[1h])) / sum by(node)(increase(node_gpu_uptime_seconds[1h]))) * 3600
```
Aim: XID rate drop >= 30% and no new dmesg OOPS for 24h.

maria: drain command we'll use for the canary nodes (kubectl hosts):
```
kubectl drain node/eu-gpu-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```
Note: we want graceful eviction to avoid long-serving batches failing.

derek: capacity/cost note: draining 5 nodes -> ~250 GPU-hours shifted to burst pool over 24h. if we spin up on-demand GPUs to absorb, estimate ~ $1,200/day extra. alternative: shift batch jobs to preemptible and throttle. need sign-off from finance if >$1k/day.

priya: also need to mark canary nodes in fleet as "no-auto-reimage" and ensure repair-queue not triggered during test. I'll push a gate to repair queue.

jonathan: telemetry gating rules to apply during canary:
- abort if gpu_xid_errors increases > 20% vs baseline in 1h
- abort if ECC uncorrected > 0 (any new UEs)
- abort if OOMs on GPU pods > 1 per host in 1h
- autoscale activations > 2x baseline (indicates hidden perf regressions)

lee: logging snippet from last week for reference (XID flood):
```
[  123.456789] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  123.460001] kernel: NVRM: RmInitAdapter failed!
[  123.460120] gpu_driver: detected ECC corrected 512 events
```

infra-bot: canary task created: kernel-backport-canary/2003456789, watches: prom/gpu-health, alert: canary-xid-abort-rule.

maria: rollout plan items:
- priya: tag and drain selected nodes (14:45 UTC)
- lee: deploy kpatch module and start monitoring (15:00 UTC)
- jonathan: own gating automation and rollback playbook
- derek: approve burst budget or throttle plan

priya: will pick nodes and post list by 14:10 UTC.

jonathan: I'll add a small smoke test that checks KV-cache warmup and sample latency on each canary host. keep smoke < 5s median.

maria: good. if we see improved XID/ECC and no regressions after 24h, we schedule broader EU rollout next Tue. :thumbsup:

lee: one more ask — add a quick kernel symbol map in the canary's debug bundle so we can faster bisect if we see OOPS.

maria: noted. closing with owners. thanks everyone.
